statement: RunPod lists Secure Cloud on-demand B300 (288 GB HBM3e) at $7.89 per GPU-hour.
why: The top listed tier shows what the newest rentable part costs a buyer today.

impact.mechanism: Static rental level with no stated baseline or change; carried as a display overlay only, not as a demand or supply signal.

confidence.basis: Vendor's own published Secure Cloud price page; list rate, not transacted, and community/spot tier was not broken out in the fetch.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: value 1.59 -> 7.89 (tol 1%); sources: RunPod
